articles.title: 10-year Treasury yield hits 5%, critical threshold for US economy and markets | CNN Business
articles.description: The rise in bond yields hit a critical threshold on Monday, with the 10-year Treasury yield rising to 5%, a level briefly touched in 2023 and otherwise not seen since 2007. The move in the key benchmark could mean higher costs for Americans who want to buy a …
